name: Remote Transmitter → Transmit Drayton
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions/#all-actions) sends a Drayton Digistat RF remote code to a remote transmitter.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The 16-bit address to send, see dumper output for more info. It is the 12-bit thermostat ID followed by a 4-bit pairing field. The pairing field is normally 0; setting bit 0 lets a receiver in pairing mode learn the ID.

config_entries.label: Channel
config_entries.description:
**Set together — all of these must be set, or all left blank:** `channel`, `command`.

The legacy 5-bit channel, the low 5 checksum bits. Range is `0` to `0x1F`. Must be used together with `command`; kept for configurations written for the first Drayton release.

config_entries.label: Command
config_entries.description:
**Set together — all of these must be set, or all left blank:** `channel`, `command`.

**Required — set exactly one of:** `data`, `command`.

The legacy 7-bit command, the 4 data bits followed by the top 3 checksum bits. Range is `0` to `0x7F`. Must be used together with `channel`. The packet is sent from `channel` and `command` as they are, with no checksum calculated.

config_entries.label: Data
config_entries.description:
**Required — set exactly one of:** `data`, `command`.

The 4-bit data value to send. Range is `0` to `0xF`. Bit `0x8` means the thermostat calls for heat and bit `0x2` means low battery, so `0x8` is On with the battery OK and `0x0` is Off. The other two bits have not been seen set. The checksum is calculated and added for you. Cannot be used with `channel` and `command`.

config_entries.label: Transmitter ID
config_entries.description: The remote transmitter to send the remote code with. Defaults to the first one defined in the configuration.

config_entries.label: Repeat
config_entries.description: Defines the number of times the code is repeated when transmitted. By default, codes are sent only once.
